notes:
Two-phase evaluation: Hosted API POC -> Dedicated pricing negotiation. POC summary: 2-week Hosted API trial (Jan 6-20), integrated embeddings for personalization and reranking pipelines; latency ~55ms p50 on 8k context, cost tracked per-token. Outcome: product team happy with quality; ops flagged cost variability at scale.

Senior engs: "we need predictable unit economics for launch Q3". Primary ask now is a Dedicated commitment that lets them hit < $0.002/token equivalent for production workloads and predictable monthly invoicing. They want explicit ramp schedule (month-by-month committed GPU hours), a burst policy for 20-30% extra capacity without immediate overage penalties, and a clear overage rate (negotiating 1.25x-1.5x of committed rate).

Procurement notes: mid-market purchasing cadence. Finance requests a 12-month term with quarterly review points and ability to reallocate unused credits across projects (or receive partial credits). Legal pushing back on Redwood MSA IP/data residency language; needs SOC2 certificate and KMS/HSM integration details for field security review. Security wants audit logging retention 13 months and option for EU region residency for EU customers.

Recent pricing conversations: proposed options from Redwood: (A) 12m commit 120k GPU-hours w/ 15% burst and 1.5x overage; (B) 9m pilot commit 60k GPU-hours + buy-forward credits; (C) 12m higher commit 180k with 25% burst credit and price step-down at 12 months. Driftstone prefers (C) if Redwood adds underutilization refund floor (min 80% utilization per quarter) or credits.

Technical highlights from SE review (Marco): live demo 2025-02-05 — routing policy and KV cache integration looked good; recommend dedicated quantized model builds to reduce GPU-hours by ~20% in steady-state. SE asked for sample perf profile for 8k/16k contexts on DGX A100-equivalent.

POC deliverables completed: ingest pipeline, eval set (1.2k prompts), perf/cost dashboard. Open items: final committed hours table, ramp schedule (months 1-6), SLA on latency p90 for portal users, exact billing cadence.

Next steps (short): AE to send revised term sheet with two pricing options (preferred C + fallback A), SE to attach perf matrix and recommended quantization configs, legal to circulate MSA redlines by 2025-02-28. Finance to confirm internal budget by 2025-03-10.

Stated quote from CTO on call 2025-02-10: "We can trade upfront commitment for predictable unit cost; need guarantees around burst and overage math or we won't commit."
